submissions.notes:
## Idea

A plain SPHINCS-style hypertree with 64-byte leaves.

## Result

First verified record: 7856 bytes, 1024 hash-work units.

## What did not work

Nothing yet; this is the baseline.

## Next

Shorter WOTS chains.

## Idea

Target-sum encoding cuts the signature but adds two hashes per chain.

## Result

6144 × 1200: a new best score.

## What did not work

Encoding with a larger alphabet made verification slower than it saved in bytes.

## Next

Compress the authentication paths.

## Idea

Trade bytes for verification work: wider trees, fewer hashes.

## Result

Not the best product, but a new frontier point at 810 hash-work units.

## What did not work

The first attempt failed the 2^-128 signing-failure gate.

## Next

Recover some bytes with a shared public seed.

## Idea

Merkle path compression from the ots.golf notes.

## Result

5632 × 1160, the current best score.

## What did not work

A 3-ary tree looked promising but the security bound lost 2 bits.

## Next

A better bound for the 3-ary variant.

## Idea

Re-derive the last record with a cleaner proof.

## Result

Verified, dominated by the record on both axes.

## Next

Nothing; the notes are the point.
